**Vertex is pleased to participate in the SAP Global Trade & Tax Conference 2026, bringing together tax, trade, customs, and technology leaders to explore the trends and innovations shaping the future of compliance.**


As regulatory requirements continue to evolve, organisations are navigating an increasingly complex landscape of indirect tax, customs, e-invoicing, and global trade obligations. The conference provides a valuable opportunity to exchange insights, share best practices, and discuss how technology can help simplify compliance while supporting broader business transformation initiatives.


Connect with Vertex to learn how SAP and Vertex work together to help organisations streamline tax and trade processes, reduce compliance risk, and build a more agile, future-ready strategy for a rapidly changing regulatory environment.
